summary: Wrote an 8-phase implementation plan from the research report, covering all seven doctrine items, the scope-note ruling, and the --depends-on-add primitive, with every edit confined to the five declared source-store file_scope paths plus a specs/ state write. Planning surfaced one constraint research did not: the eager-context budget has 9 bytes of headroom (live TOTAL 65941 B vs baseline_bytes 65950) and verify-deploy.sh Gate 20 fail()s on any regression, so Item 1's claudemd.md addition must be byte-neutral via an offsetting in-file trim, and orchestrator-context-budget.json is out of file_scope so the baseline cannot be moved. Phase tiers were grounded mechanically by running suite_selection_select against each touched path (two returned __FULL_SWEEP__, which the justifications state honestly rather than claiming a covering suite). The plan passes validate-artifact.sh in both default and --strict mode with 0 warnings.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan: guardrails doctrine edits (Rule 1 narrowness test + cap-fallback pointer, owner-blocked carve-out, batch-plan rendering rule, scope-note amendment), multi-task-operations.md overlap-to-edge default move, --depends-on-add with write-time cycle refusal reusing validate-state.sh, two mandated fixtures, byte-neutral claudemd.md posture statement, suggester spec re-point, and a final full-gate phase.
